title: The evening sculpture lantern walk
titleZh: 雕塑提燈夜遊行前通知
passage:
Sculpture Lantern Walk
Note from the neighborhood arts group

We will start in the alley behind the theater at 7 p.m. The walk is free, and you do not need to reserve a place. If you want to carry one of our lanterns, bring a coin for the deposit. It will be returned when you hand your lantern to a guide. You may bring your own lantern, but please use one with a battery, not a flame.

We have two routes. The long route crosses a bridge. The short route stays on this side of the canal and reaches the last sculpture by the ramp from Market Lane. Both routes include the projection on the theater wall at the start. Only the long route stops at the artist’s studio for questions before it closes to visitors at 7:30.

If there is a strong wind, the bridge will close before we set out. In that case, the group will take the short route, and the artist will answer questions at the last sculpture instead of at the studio. The theater projection will still happen. If you plan to leave early, hand your borrowed lantern to any guide in a yellow vest before you go. Please don’t leave it beside a sculpture.
passageZh:
雕塑提燈夜遊
社區藝術團體通知

晚上七點在劇院後方的巷子集合出發。活動免費，不必預約。若想拿我們的提燈，請帶一枚硬幣當押金。把提燈交給導覽員後，就會退還押金。也可以自帶提燈，但請用電池式的，不要用明火。

路線有兩條。長路線會過橋。短路線留在運河這一側，從市場巷的坡道前往最後一座雕塑。兩條線一開始都會看劇院牆上的投影。只有長路線會在藝術家的工作室停留問答；工作室晚上七點半關閉，不再開放參觀。

如果風勢強，橋會在出發前關閉。屆時團體走短路線，藝術家也會改在最後一座雕塑前回答問題，不在工作室。劇院投影照常。如果你打算提早離開，請在走之前把借來的提燈交給任一位穿黃色背心的導覽員。請勿把提燈留在雕塑旁。
